# ShareTheMeal

> A mobile-first web app for donating surplus food. Donors pick a nearby NGO or hunger spot, describe the food, choose a pickup slot and track every donation they post.

ShareTheMeal is a portfolio project by Harsh Narain. The public site runs in demo mode: visitors use it as a guest, the NGOs are fictional (based in Pune), and donations are stored only in the visitor's own browser.

## Pages

- [Home](/): A welcome for first-time visitors, NGO search, NGOs sorted by distance from the visitor, the NGOs that need the most food, and upcoming campaigns.
- [NGOs](/ngos): Every NGO, with how many meals it needs and by when.
- [Donate](/donate): A four-step flow: category, food details, pickup details, delivery.
- [Activity](/activity): Donations you have posted, with their status and a way to cancel them.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/hersh11/sharethemealapp): React 19, React Router 8, Vite, Vitest.
